name: AWA — American Women's Association
summary: Long-running association for friendship, volunteering, and newcomer orientation — high ROI in the first 90 days.
body: AWA helps arriving partners and professionals plug into interest groups, volunteering, and social circles. In practice it is often broader than ‘Americans only’ — confirm current membership openness. Interest groups and volunteer days drive the value more than formal dinners. Frequently recommended alongside Bumble BFF and Meetup when Reddit newcomers ask how to meet women friends in male-heavy workplaces. Pair with giving.sg for additional volunteer shifts.
membershipNotes: Annual dues; interest groups and volunteering drive the value. Verify live requirements.
